Archery

  • Ten arrows at one target. Aim with the mouse, or drag on a touch screen. Hold to draw the bow, let go to shoot. Arrow keys and space work too.
  • A full draw takes about half a second. Shoot too soon and the arrow is slow and drops; hold too long and your arm starts to shake.
  • The rings score 10 at the centre down to 1 at the edge, so the most is 100.
  • Arrows fall on their way, so aim a little high, and the wind pushes them sideways: watch the windsocks. It changes every arrow.
